name: Somchai Wisutthisopon
bio:
Somchai's passion for motorsport ignited during his university days, where he studied Mechanical Engineering at Chulalongkorn University. He excelled in vehicle dynamics and simulation, leading him to an internship with a local touring car team. There, he quickly proved his mettle, contributing to significant performance improvements through meticulous data analysis and innovative setup adjustments. 

After graduation, Somchai joined a smaller Formula series team, further honing his skills in real-time data interpretation and driver communication. Known for his calm demeanor even under immense pressure, Somchai thrives on the challenge of optimizing car performance. He believes in a holistic approach, combining technical expertise with effective management to extract the best possible results. His dedication and loyalty make him a valuable asset to any team, and he’s always eager to learn and contribute to the team's success at Blau Motorsport.

His approach to performance engineering prioritizes clear communication with the driver and mechanics, ensuring everyone is aligned on the strategy and goals. He's particularly adept at translating complex data into actionable insights, which helps the team make informed decisions during races and testing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Somchai has a lean build and a focused gaze.
